meta.description: SOP §4 (employment verification) — one email per prior employer's HR for factual verification. Triggered by POST /webhook/onb-employment-verification with { onboarderId, template, event, context: { verification_id, company, hr_contact_name, hr_email, full_name, role_title, onboarding_lead } }. After import, replace `REPLACE_ME` Gmail credential ID, then activate. Env: N8N_EMPLOYMENT_VERIFICATION_URL.
